title: OUT OF LIFE
lines: Out of life is an underwater data center.
It keeps 1,546 shots from 121 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 15 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Dim bedroom”.
The tallest tower is All My Babies (1953): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1906 or newer than 2019.
The sign most often read here is index of equivocity.
